snippet.title: Ladder Lad - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description: Here's your look at the Ladder Lad announcement trailer for this upcoming 2D platformer game all about ladders. In a world that has forgotten how to jump, ladders have become the only means of upward mobility. As the titular Lad, scale a whimsical ladder-shaped tower with nothing more than a personal ladder and a healthy serving of creative climbing. Ladder Lad will be available on PC via Steam and Nintendo Switch in 2027.
